dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a smooth spline toward the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly directed slope at approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is significantly greater than the vertical height, approximately 1.8:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Wide obtuse angle at the transition from the melon to the rostrum.
